answer: In Proof of Agent, each identity posts bonded collateral in a separate escrow, but correlated equivocation links their evidence and triggers a quadratic penalty: coordinating k identities costs O(k²) in slashed collateral. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, making concealed control rapidly uneconomic. Like a reef of marble nodes transmitting a ripple, one proven fault can expose and devalue the entire coordinated cluster.
